subject: IAM evidence request & SOC 2 status  next steps
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: John Doe <john.doe@vastlyhealth.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 25 Feb 2027 15:12:00 -0800
Subject: IAM evidence request & SOC 2 status  next steps

Hi John 

Thanks again for the time on today’s call. Quick recap and the pieces we discussed so your security team can kick off their review: 

- SOC 2 status: you mentioned an ongoing Type II audit with an expected report in Q2. Can you confirm whether you have a SOC 2 Type II assertion or just an interim status at the moment?
- SSO / SAML: we need IdP metadata (entityID, x509 cert, ACS URLs) and whether you support SP-initiated and IdP-initiated flows.
- SCIM: confirm whether SCIM v2 provisioning is supported and the attribute set (email, name, title, groups). If you don’t support SCIM we’ll note manual provisioning implications.
- RBAC / admin controls: a one-page summary of admin roles, ability to delegate, and any enforced MFA for admin accounts would be helpful.
- Vendor security questionnaire: if you want to start with your standard questionnaire, please send it over. We’ll run it through our security team and return a completed copy.

I’m attaching a short SOC 2 summary and our SSO/SCIM guidance to show the specific evidence types our security reviewers typically request (redwood-soc2-summary.pdf, redwood-sso-guidance.pdf).

Can you kick this off with your security ops and send the IdP metadata and SOC 2 artifact you have today? If it’s easier, we can set a 30-min follow-up next week for the security folks to sync.

Thanks 
Marissa Cole
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com

Attachments: redwood-soc2-summary.pdf, redwood-sso-guidance.pdf

From: John Doe <john.doe@vastlyhealth.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: security@vastlyhealth.com
Date: Fri, 26 Feb 2027 09:03:00 -0500
Subject: Re: IAM evidence request & SOC 2 status  next steps

Hi Marissa 

Appreciate the concise list and the attachments  very helpful. Quick answers and what I’ve attached: 

- SOC 2: we have a completed SOC 2 Type II assertion for the period ending 2026-11-30. I’ve attached the assertion (vastly-soc2-assertion.pdf).
- SSO / SAML: attaching our IdP metadata (vastly-idp-metadata.xml). We support both SP-initiated and IdP-initiated flows; ACS URL(s) are listed in the metadata.
- SCIM: we currently do NOT have SCIM provisioning enabled for external vendors; we support Just-In-Time provisioning via SAML attributes.
- RBAC/admin: I’ve looped in security@vastlyhealth.com to provide a one-page roles breakdown if needed.

We also have a standard vendor security questionnaire  I can send that over if you’d like us to start there.

Next steps from our side: I’ll let our security lead (cc’d) add the RBAC doc and we’ll target sending the questionnaire by end of day Monday.

Thanks 
John
Senior IT Security Manager
Vastly Health

Attachments: vastly-soc2-assertion.pdf, vastly-idp-metadata.xml

From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
To: John Doe <john.doe@vastlyhealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 26 Feb 2027 11:20:00 -0800
Subject: Re: IAM evidence request & SOC 2 status  next steps

John 

Great, thanks for sending the SOC 2 assertion and IdP metadata. A couple quick clarifications from our security team so they can mark items off in the questionnaire: 

1) SCIM: since SCIM isn’t supported today, can you confirm whether you would consider enabling SCIM for vendor provisioning (SCIM v2, bearer token with HTTPS) within a 90-day roadmap? If not, we’ll outline the manual provisioning process and associated admin controls required.

2) Admin roles: when security@vastlyhealth.com shares the one-pager, can you include whether: 
   - Admin role assignments are logged and audited (SIEM/syslog integration)
   - MFA is enforced for all admin/root-level console access
   - There is a process for emergency access / break-glass and how it is reviewed

I’ve attached the following artifacts to illustrate the evidence our reviewers prefer: redwood-scim-spec.md (SCIM attribute mapping we expect) and redwood-rbac-matrix.xlsx (example role matrix).

If it helps, we can schedule a 30-minute security-to-security sync next Tue/Wed. What windows work for you and your security lead?

Best 
Aditya Rao
Product Security, Redwood Inference
aditya_rao@redwood.com

Attachments: redwood-scim-spec.md, redwood-rbac-matrix.xlsx
